items.title: Surfer 2
items.content_text: Surfer 2 is a computer-use agent for desktop, web and mobile tasks. Its orchestrator assigns subtasks while components handle visual grounding and execution.
items.summary: Surfer 2 is a computer-use agent for desktop, web and mobile tasks. Its orchestrator assigns subtasks while components handle visual grounding and execution.

items.title: cua-s1-forms
items.content_text: A 706,048-parameter checkpoint that scores candidate actions for GUI form fields in parallel. It is released as safetensors weights with a configuration file.
items.summary: A 706,048-parameter checkpoint that scores candidate actions for GUI form fields in parallel. It is released as safetensors weights with a configuration file.

items.title: Holo-3.1-35B-A3B-FP8
items.content_text: An FP8 checkpoint in the Holo3.1 vision-language model family for computer-use agents. The card describes web, desktop and mobile tasks and links to deployment guidance.
items.summary: An FP8 checkpoint in the Holo3.1 vision-language model family for computer-use agents. The card describes web, desktop and mobile tasks and links to deployment guidance.

items.title: Kimi-VL-A3B-Thinking-2506
items.content_text: A multimodal reasoning model with released weights and high-resolution image input. Its authors report GUI grounding evaluations on ScreenSpot-Pro, ScreenSpot-V2 and OSWorld-G.
items.summary: A multimodal reasoning model with released weights and high-resolution image input. Its authors report GUI grounding evaluations on ScreenSpot-Pro, ScreenSpot-V2 and OSWorld-G.

items.title: RICO-ScreenQA-Short
items.content_text: A screen question-answering dataset based on RICO interface images, pairing questions with machine-generated short answers. It provides train, validation and test splits.
items.summary: A screen question-answering dataset based on RICO interface images, pairing questions with machine-generated short answers. It provides train, validation and test splits.

items.title: Browserless
items.content_text: Browserless runs headless browsers as a Docker service for Puppeteer and Playwright scripts, with session concurrency controls and a live debugging view.
items.summary: Browserless runs headless browsers as a Docker service for Puppeteer and Playwright scripts, with session concurrency controls and a live debugging view.

items.title: Holo-3.1-35B-A3B-NVFP4
items.content_text: Holo-3.1-35B-A3B-NVFP4 is a quantized computer-use vision-language checkpoint for web, desktop and mobile tasks, with function-calling support.
items.summary: Holo-3.1-35B-A3B-NVFP4 is a quantized computer-use vision-language checkpoint for web, desktop and mobile tasks, with function-calling support.

items.title: MultimodalWebSurfer
items.content_text: MultimodalWebSurfer operates a Chromium browser through Playwright, using marked screenshots and a multimodal model to choose actions on web pages.
items.summary: MultimodalWebSurfer operates a Chromium browser through Playwright, using marked screenshots and a multimodal model to choose actions on web pages.
